early-service-consent-2026-10-19.lt: Prašau teikti paslaugą pasirinktu vizito laiku, net jei 14 dienų sutarties atsisakymo terminas dar nepasibaigęs. Suprantu, kad visiškai suteikus paslaugą neteksiu teisės atsisakyti sutarties.
early-service-consent-2026-10-19.en: I request the service at the selected appointment time, even if the 14-day withdrawal period has not ended. I understand that I will lose the right to withdraw once the service is fully performed.
